criterion: which assistant-command intent the utterance expresses, that is what the user wants done

categories.name: Create Alarm
categories.definition: Set a new alarm for a specific time or recurrence.

categories.name: Modify Alarm
categories.definition: Change an existing alarm's time, snooze, or other settings.

categories.name: Delete Alarm
categories.definition: Remove one or more alarms.

categories.name: Create Reminder
categories.definition: Set a new reminder for a task, event, or general note.

categories.name: Modify Reminder
categories.definition: Change an existing reminder's details.

categories.name: Delete Reminder
categories.definition: Remove one or more reminders.

categories.name: Query Reminder
categories.definition: Ask for information about existing reminders.

categories.name: Create Timer
categories.definition: Start a new countdown timer for a specified duration.

categories.name: Modify Timer
categories.definition: Adjust an active timer's duration.

categories.name: Delete Timer
categories.definition: Stop and remove an active timer.

categories.name: Query Timer
categories.definition: Ask for information about an active timer.

categories.name: Control Timer
categories.definition: Start, stop, or restart a timer.

categories.name: Initiate Call
categories.definition: Start a voice or video call with a contact or group.

categories.name: Manage Call
categories.definition: Control an ongoing call, such as pausing, hanging up, switching to video, or adding participants.

categories.name: Initiate Message
categories.definition: Send a text, chat, or video message to a contact or group.

categories.name: Query Communication History
categories.definition: Ask for information about past calls or messages.

categories.name: Set Status/Availability
categories.definition: Update the user's online status or availability.

categories.name: Query Status/Availability
categories.definition: Ask for information about a contact's online status or availability.

categories.name: Query Weather
categories.definition: Ask for current or future weather conditions.

categories.name: Query News/Headlines
categories.definition: Ask for current news or headlines.

categories.name: Query Events/Activities
categories.definition: Ask for information about local or upcoming events.

categories.name: Query People/Contacts Information
categories.definition: Ask for details about contacts or people, such as who works where, birthdays, or relationships.

categories.name: Query Food/Recipe/Nutrition Information
categories.definition: Ask for recipes, cooking instructions, or nutritional facts.

categories.name: Query General Information
categories.definition: Ask for factual information or details on a broad range of topics not covered by other query categories.

categories.name: Play Music
categories.definition: Start playing music by artist, song, album, genre, or playlist.

categories.name: Control Music Playback
categories.definition: Control ongoing music playback, such as skipping, repeating, or going back.

categories.name: Set Default Application
categories.definition: Change the default application for a specific function.

categories.name: Display Information
categories.definition: Request to show specific information on screen without necessarily querying its state.

categories.name: Decline Event
categories.definition: Indicate refusal to attend an event.
